assumptions: No clinical model or history definition approved.
Established clinical status is an explicit applicability input; a first-time case is not_applicable with no posterior claim, never a negative finding or a fake negative clozapine posterior.
All 23 BN-07 distributions were missing and are synthetic uniform references here; complete clinical table provenance remains a release blocker.
Whether review outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this draft uses estimated-table semantics without approval.
Trial-adequacy and observation-window operationalization, and monitoring/willingness input meanings, are open assumptions for owner review; no duration, dose or adherence thresholds are set here.
source_comparison: See source_diff and source_comparison_details: all 23 BN-07 variables, states and ordered proposed_parent edges retained with no removals, renames or state extensions; 15 roots plus 8 outputs materialize every proposed_parent as an ordered GIVEN. Original BN SHA pinned and untouched.

source_comparison_details.bn_parameter_inventory: 23 run-specific distributions to supply; 0 editable source-lookup examples supplied; all awaiting_experiment_cpt in BN-07

explicit_graph: Fixed 23-node nature-only graph in BN-07 order; source_comparison_details lists every retained ordered parent. All proposed_parent metadata is materialized as GIVENs in declared order. Edges are modeler-synthesized review candidates, not established causal facts. This R7 registration package has a distinct network identity from the separate F5 no-improvement follow-up even though BN-07 concepts overlap.
reference_table_provenance: BN-07 supplies zero fixed tables; all 23 distributions were awaiting_experiment_cpt. Draft network.xml holds explicitly synthetic uniform references (2-state 0.5/0.5, 4-state 0.25 each, 3-state thirds, outputs uniform per row) with no source lookup to audit. The numerical fixture CPTs are independent synthetic mathematical references with worked marginals, not source-backed clinical probabilities; complete clinical table provenance and calibration remain release blockers.
estimation_instructions: prompt.txt requires all CPTs including roots, percentage strings, fixed order and empty evidence, with R7 registration identity distinct from F5 follow-up, trial-adequacy and observation-window review without invented thresholds or regimen fields, monitoring/willingness use only as defined and collected, and parallel urgent handling. Whether outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption recorded here; the draft uses estimated-table semantics without approval.
result_mapping: template.json defines candidate state-specific review language for all 8 queried outputs (22 branches) plus parallel urgent banner from saved inputs; every distribution remains visible. No threshold, posterior ranking or automatic treatment choice exists. Clinical branch selection and rendering remain S45 and owner review.
numerical_examples: examples.json contains one complete independently worked 23-node mathematical reference: TwoAdequate Yes 0.4 with a Trial1/Trial2 transpose guard (swapped gives 0.32), TreatmentResistantSchizophreniaReview Triggered 0.252, AdditionalResearchFeatures Present 0.606 with an ordered-parent transpose guard (swapped gives 0.576), PriorTrialAdequacyReview Triggered 0.51, Preparation Prepared 0.336, Pathway 0.2/0.24/0.16/0.2992/0.0338688/0.0669312 with urgent 0.2 preserved, ExposureReview Triggered 0.15, PersistentSymptomsReview 0.5/0.3/0.08/0.12. Two opposing projections of the same CPT yield identical posteriors, proving no clamping. This validates math and engineering only; clinical expected_for_review cases remain unapproved.
clinical_examples: examples.json contains 6 clinical review candidates: established applicable gate true, gate true with urgent Present, first-time gate false not_applicable with not_a_negative_posterior and no posterior claim, gate unknown, missing trial-context and gate conflict needs_clarification. These are proposed gate, trial-context, provenance and wording expectations, not self-validating clinical tests or implemented runtime claims.
admission_measurements: Measured 23 nature nodes, 125 rows, 375 cells, 14696 compact CPT payload bytes, 39286 network XML bytes and 37538 effective XML bytes. Focused 6-test suite passed in 3.60 s. Full-graph 2 inference + 1 replay measured 3.414 s combined (infer 1.144 s + 1.160 s, replay 1.110 s) within 1e-6; opposing provenance never clamps. Memory ceiling and provider capacity remain unmeasured and clinical release is blocked awaiting review.
open_assumptions: Candidate 15-field history with trial-history, observation-window and current-encounter synthesis provenance, gate true/false/unknown definitions with first-time not_applicable semantics, urgent-banner independence, trial-adequacy and observation-window operationalization with no invented thresholds, monitoring and willingness input meanings, deterministic-rule versus estimated-table output semantics, full clinical CPT provenance and final wording all require review before release. History v1, runtime projections and readiness (S40) and rendering (S45) remain unchanged. This R7 registration package stays distinct from the F5 no-improvement follow-up package.
